title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity bump v1.134.0
author: Aisha Kumar
release_notes: Unified SDK auth/retries/streaming ergonomics and parity bump to v1.134.0. See migration notes in docs/sdk-migrations.md.
description: Context: This PR unifies auth and retry ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, fixes long-standing streaming edge cases, and bumps SDK parity to v1.134.0. Motivation: downstream teams reported inconsistencies between SDKs around retry backoff, token refresh during long-lived streams, and minor differences in response object shapes. Goal: make behavior consistent, improve developer ergonomics, and cut a parity release. Summary of changes: - Introduced a shared auth adapter interface and thin language bindings for token refresh. - Standardized retry policy config (max_attempts, base_backoff_ms, jitter) and added deterministic unit tests. - Fixed streaming reconnect behavior: pause/resume semantics, ensure KV cache flush hooks are idempotent on reconnects. - Ergonomics: simplified streaming iterator in Python, added async iterable support in TS, improved error typing in Go. - Version bumps: updated package.json/go.mod/pyproject to v1.134.0 and updated CHANGELOG templates. Commits (high level): - feat(auth): shared adapter + refresh events - feat(retries): single policy implementation + tests - fix(streaming): reconnect resume fix + idempotent hooks - chore(version): bump sdks to v1.134.0 - docs: update examples and migration notes Files touched (summary): - sdks/python/redwood_sdk/auth.py (new adapter) - sdks/typescript/src/auth/*.ts (bindings + tests) - sdks/go/auth/adapter.go (adapter + docs) - sdks/*/retries/* (policy consolidation) - sdks/*/streaming/* (iterator/reconnect fixes) - examples/streaming-reconnect/ (updated examples) - docs/sdk-migrations.md (migration steps) Review conversation (summary): - Benji: Requested stricter typing on JS retry options and a unit test for max_attempts edge-case. Author: added test and tightened types. - Marta: Asked for clearer migration guidance and a compatibility shim for older token providers. Author: added shim and docs section. - Diego: Verified Go error propagation and requested a small refactor to reduce code duplication. Author: refactored and ran go vet. Approvals: Benji and Diego approved after fixes; Marta approved after docs update. CI: initial run had one flaky streaming test failing on macOS runner; rerun passed. All checks green (lint, unit, integration, e2e streaming smoke). Merge: squash merged on 2026-02-28 with commit message "sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming + v1.134.0". Migration notes: short compatibility shims provided and documented for token providers that don't emit refresh events. Backwards compatibility: preserved runtime defaults but clarified config schema.
